projects.title: AI Assistant for BIS Standards
projects.role: Smart India Hackathon · Ministry of Consumer Affairs

features: Standard recommendation from a product description
BIS certification guidance and eligibility check

projects.title: STEIZEN — Rule-Based Trading Platform
projects.role: Algorithmic trading system for Nasdaq futures (MNQ / NQ)
projects.desc: A rule-based trading system that detects market structure, scores trade quality, sizes risk in R multiples, and executes through IBKR — with a full backtesting and journaling loop around it.
features: BOS / CHoCH, fair value gaps, order blocks
projects.note: Backtested results, not live trading performance.

projects.title: Streakly — Habit Tracker with Per-User Sync
projects.role: Personal build · Next.js, Supabase Auth + Postgres
projects.desc: A calm habit tracker with daily check-ins, current and longest streaks, 26-week heatmaps, a month calendar and statistics — backed by Supabase accounts and row-level security so every user's progress stays private and syncs across devices.
features: Daily check-ins with accurate current and longest streaks
Heatmap, month calendar and completion statistics
Per-user storage guarded by Postgres row-level security
Offline cache with optimistic writes and rollback
projects.note: Live in production; accounts and per-user data are handled by Supabase.
